channel.title: The Wang Report
channel.description: Independent news curation from Hong Kong: geopolitics, finance, cyber, AI, sports, science, and culture.

item.title: HKMA raises renminbi repo capacity 10% as bond bids exceed supply
item.description: The additional RMB2 billion expands dedicated funding capacity for Hong Kong’s offshore renminbi market from 27 October.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Lam

item.title: Brotli flaw reaches Python clients through packages their code never imports
item.description: This week’s disclosures put the administrator’s immediate problem inside running software, where an ordinary outbound request can bring attacker-controlled data to a vulnerable decoder.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: Elvis rights owners sue Anthropic to claim control over AI training
item.description: The company that licenses Elvis is challenging whether AI training gets to use the catalog without buying permission.
item.dc:creator: Joy Lee

item.title: Discovery Bay’s four community crews have a route to the gala final
item.description: A 400-metre course, 56 category entries and 27 races bring school newcomers, seasoned clubs and four community contenders to Tai Pak Beach.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: Morning roundup
item.description: Ukraine’s satellite access, Singapore’s cyber strategy, China’s leadership preparations, Brazil’s election and protests in France.
item.dc:creator: Charmaine Lo

item.title: Meta suspends Muse sharing after one query finds 6,800 conversation links
item.description: A web-address design made shared conversations searchable, exposing a security problem that model testing alone cannot resolve.
item.dc:creator: Aya Nakamura

item.title: US Orders Diplomatic Departures After Warning of Iranian Attacks
item.description: The withdrawal of American personnel turns an official assessment of Iranian threats into a concrete reduction of the US diplomatic presence.
item.dc:creator: Maarten Bakker

item.title: VeloCloud is under attack. Check the deployment and the version
item.description: Arista’s advisory identifies the on-premises Orchestrator releases that need updating. Collabora’s separate fix applies to the built-in Nextcloud app, not standalone servers.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: Kyrie Irving scores 24 after Cooper Flagg exits with left shoulder soreness
item.description: Dallas finished the game behind Kyrie Irving, but Flagg’s availability becomes an immediate concern with San Antonio next.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: Trump Orders Lawsuit to Block Certification if Sullivan Loses
item.description: The president says he has directed federal lawyers to challenge certification if Alaska's Republican incumbent loses, putting government authority behind a conditional electoral intervention.
item.dc:creator: Charmaine Lo

item.title: Cinema owners give Elizabeth Holmes documentary 2,600 theaters to fill
item.description: Cinema owners are giving a surprise documentary hit room to compete with Warner’s latest Batman villain.
item.dc:creator: Joy Lee

item.title: Star Ferry fares rise on 25 January, with monthly passes held at HK$190
item.description: The approved increase affects Central and Wan Chai crossings to Tsim Sha Tsui. Weekday fares rise by HK$0.60 to HK$1; weekend fares by HK$1 to HK$1.80.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: PHP has no patch for remote code execution flaw in non-default configurations
item.description: Administrators running affected configurations need a change process that can authorise mitigation while a software fix is unavailable.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: Taste Gourmet’s Main Board bid is tied to SFC market manipulation proceedings
item.description: Holders backing the proposed Main Board transfer now have an enforcement case attached to the event they are pricing.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Lam

item.title: State Investor Buying Helps Chinese Stocks Reverse Losses
item.description: China's market recovery shows the influence of state investors, even as a wider Asian technology selloff exposes the limits of that support.
item.dc:creator: Maarten Bakker

item.title: ConnectWise compromise leaves access open where supplier credentials still work
item.description: For customers assessing the reported compromise, the immediate exposure is the access their own systems still grant the supplier.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: LiteLLM breach shows model tests offer no assurance over credential safety
item.description: The compromise puts connection software inside the supplier decision for Hong Kong licensed firms adopting AI.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Lam

item.title: Iran Reports Seven Tankers Hit in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Reported attacks on oil tankers have turned renewed conflict fears into higher energy prices and a sharp fall in technology shares.
item.dc:creator: Charmaine Lo

item.title: DeepSeek’s direct API price depends on when you use it
item.description: Flash output costs US$0.60 or US$1.20 per million tokens under the provider’s current schedule. A ledger quote cannot establish a vendor price cut.
item.dc:creator: Aya Nakamura

item.title: Hong Kong adds 6,000 buildings to fire alarm scheme with none installed
item.description: Residents are still waiting for alarms while the government adds more buildings to the scheme.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: LiteLLM credential thief spread through its PyPI package and Docker images
item.description: Recovery depends on whether the application receiving replacement credentials still contains the code that stole the originals.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: Hang Seng falls 3% as HIBOR sets the borrowing bill for financed holdings
item.description: For the portfolio manager marking down Hong Kong equities, the next funding readings will help distinguish an equity sell-off from pressure on Hong Kong dollar funding.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Lam

item.title: Alibaba Shares Fall After Chinese Regulators Summon E-commerce Operators
item.description: A regulatory summons deepened Hong Kong's technology selloff, with confidence already weakened by Chinese consumption and doubts about returns on artificial intelligence.
item.dc:creator: Maarten Bakker

item.title: Cashman keeps Yankees job and will evaluate players blamed for playoff exit
item.description: New York’s owner has settled who keeps running the club, leaving the clubhouse to absorb his verdict on October.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: Palo Alto GlobalProtect attacks send banks back to June for access records
item.description: For Hong Kong banks investigating earlier access, the technology risk question reaches beyond the fix to whether the evidence survived.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Lam

item.title: Critical PHP Flaws Force Websites Offline Across the World
item.description: Flaws in a widely used web language have turned a software security release into a global disruption, with exploitation reported before fixes arrived.
item.dc:creator: Charmaine Lo

item.title: Wembanyama misses his first 12 shots in opening loss to Thunder
item.description: Oklahoma City turned opening night into an ordeal for one of basketball’s biggest attractions.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: Queen Elizabeth Hospital's phased move leaves services split across two sites
item.description: Patients need to check where their appointment is happening while services move between the two hospitals.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Ransomware groups exploited Palo Alto GlobalProtect months before warning
item.description: Investigating earlier access depends on VPN records that a later fix cannot recover.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: HIBOR falls 21 basis points, with renminbi bond savings hinging on funding costs
item.description: A bank treasury desk weighing the sovereign issue against Hong Kong dollar bills has to price the funding in the currency it will actually owe.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Lam

item.title: Attackers Use Stolen UpdraftCentral Keys to Backdoor WordPress Sites
item.description: A breach at a backup provider exposes the authority carried by its management connections, leaving recovery dependent on more than removing malicious files.
item.dc:creator: Maarten Bakker

item.title: Stolen UpdraftCentral keys leave WordPress sites exposed after cleanup
item.description: Recovery depends on establishing whether the connection trusted to manage a site still accepts commands under a stolen key.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: ARTEX used to breach about 20 Japanese firms, with no entry flaw identified
item.description: Hong Kong licensed firms have an existing regulatory obligation to address AI-enabled attacks, while the Japanese report supplies no entry weakness to test against.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Lam

item.title: Google Restores Cloud Service After Outage Disrupts Banks
item.description: The disruption shows how financial services can depend on shared infrastructure, allowing one technology failure to interrupt several apparently separate businesses.
item.dc:creator: Charmaine Lo

item.title: Netflix replaces content chiefs as revenue growth slows and Below tops its chart
item.description: A hit with 21 million views offers little job security when the company wants more viewing across the service.
item.dc:creator: Joy Lee

item.title: Terry McLaurin’s torn patellar tendon leaves Washington without him for season
item.description: Washington loses its receiver after pushing unbeaten San Francisco hard, while the NFL’s season continues.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: ARTEX linked to breaches at about 20 Japanese firms, entry route unreported
item.description: The tool previously reported in South Korean bank attacks has surfaced in Japan, leaving administrators to establish how it entered and whether that route still works.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: MTR bets billions on Northern Metropolis rail as land returns lag
item.description: The funding gap lands with MTR, which must finance the railway while waiting for the development money.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: United States Bans DeepSeek From Civilian Government Agencies
item.description: Washington’s expanded restrictions make access to government business a question of national rivalry, with consequences that extend beyond an AI model’s capabilities.
item.dc:creator: Maarten Bakker

item.title: Beijing vows South China Sea measures as Manila protests war remarks
item.description: A summons puts the dispute before China's ambassador while the practical consequences remain with the people operating at sea.
item.dc:creator: Vincent Lai

item.title: AWS Security Agent exploits 33 of 37 flaws, leaving access limits unproven
item.description: An autonomous security tester’s results make its access permissions part of the purchasing decision.
item.dc:creator: Aya Nakamura

item.title: French Authorities Impose Curfews After Riots Overwhelm Police
item.description: Restrictions in Paris and other cities bring a confrontation over policing and living conditions into the daily lives of people beyond the protests.
item.dc:creator: Charmaine Lo

item.title: Shawn Armstrong opens Game 6 with Cleveland's season riding on its bullpen
item.description: Cleveland’s bullpen must survive Game 6 one handover at a time, with every unfinished inning becoming somebody else’s emergency.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: Taiwan Detains Two Drone Executives Over Chinese Chips in Military Contracts
item.description: The detentions put suppliers under scrutiny, with the consequences for contracted equipment still unestablished.
item.dc:creator: Mei Chen

item.title: BeyondTrust vault theft leaves stolen passwords working after the fix
item.description: Administrators face a recovery job that extends to every system accepting a password copied from the vault.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: SFC suspends Baicha shares over suspected IPO rigging, blocking sales
item.description: For existing holders, the immediate consequence is an unavailable exit, while a separate circular puts sponsors, bookbuilders and placing firms in the regulatory frame.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Lam

item.title: Philippines Summons Chinese Envoy Over Threat Of Force
item.description: Manila's diplomatic response makes Beijing answer for threatening language over disputed waters, without resolving the disagreement that gave those words their force.
item.dc:creator: Maarten Bakker

item.title: Broadcom Wi-Fi flaw leaves routers exposed even when passwords stay secret
item.description: A nearby attacker can gain root access without joining the network, leaving owners with a service decision while the flaw remains unpatched.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: ConnectWise halts customers' cloud backup in unauthorized access probe
item.description: Customers lost backup service during containment, exposing how closely recovery depends on the application access a provider may need to revoke.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: Packers beat Cowboys 23-13 as Chiefs hold Chargers to six and reach 5-0
item.description: Dallas supplied the Sunday-night frustration, Kansas City kept winning, and Arizona handed its entire scoring operation to a kicker.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee
